title: Start a project for a client

steps.caption: Clients
steps.narration: A client can have more than one job. Here is how to start a new project for one.

steps.caption: Search
steps.narration: Find the client. We'll search for Brewster.

steps.caption: Projects
steps.narration: The Projects section lists the jobs she already has.

steps.caption: Project name
steps.narration: Type a name for the job.

steps.caption: On the client's page
steps.narration: The new project is on her page, with its own number. It starts as a lead.

steps.caption: Pipeline
steps.narration: It has a card on the Pipeline too. Open Pipeline in the menu.

steps.caption: The card
steps.narration: Here it is, in the Lead column.

steps.caption: Open the project
steps.narration: Click its name to open the project page.

steps.caption: Project page
steps.narration: From here you run the job.

steps.caption: Menu: Clients
steps.narration: You'll find your clients under Clients, in the menu on the left.

youtube.title: How to start a new project for a client | ConstructHUB CRM
youtube.description: A short walkthrough of starting a project in the ConstructHUB CRM. You will open a client, choose New project, name the job, and find it on the client's page and on the Pipeline board.
